thresholds.numericDefaultRenders: exactly N for N=1,10,50 and zero observer activity
thresholds.atomicPercentageDefault: candidate renders no more than either baseline; zero active observer after final choice
thresholds.expressionDefault: same render count as candidate atomic percentage; zero active observer after final choice
thresholds.purePixelExpression: same render count as candidate numeric default with containerRef; zero observer activity
